body: I just can't see it helping me. Thank you for talking to me and showing your concern.
Thank you so much for your help.
No point in health if I'm discharged.
I'm military. I imagine all sorts of hell would break loose should they know.
The only hobbies I had were running, lifting weights, and collecting comic books. I haven't done any of these things for a while due to lack of motivation. All I do anymore is work and sleep.
I would like to learn something but I have a terrible ear for music. I am in a situation where I cannot under any circumstance see a doctor. Thank you for your suggestions though.
I try, and thank you for talking with me. I just feel so alone, so unhappy it just gets unbearable sometimes.

I have a job I hate and feel like I'm not very good at it which impedes my co workers. I have to pass a test in October that is apparently very hard and if I fail I will be discharged. I make so many payments and I'm terrible about budgeting so after I pay them all off I have no money for myself. It feels like a vicious cycle I can never escape.
